target.title: [codex] Refine quota warning markers for updated UI
target.body:
## Summary

- Render quota warning markers with the same punch-out treatment as the pace stripe.
- Make warning markers full-height with a slimmer neutral stripe so they stay visible in the updated UI without looking like the green pace marker.
- Add geometry coverage for full-height marker placement and display-scale centering.

## Why replace the softened marker style

The previous softened marker was an inset hairline. In the updated menu-card UI it could visually disappear into the filled progress bar and it did not align with the existing pace marker language. The full-height punch-out treatment reuses the established pace-stripe rendering model: first cut through the accumulated track/fill pixels, then draw a slimmer neutral stripe. This keeps quota warning thresholds visible in both filled and track regions while keeping them visually distinct from the green pace marker.

## Visual proof

Redacted local runtime menu-card crops are below. Private account details, email addresses, and cost sections are excluded by cropping to the marker rows.

Before: softened 1px-style warning marker in a normal row.

![Before: softened 1px quota warning marker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alekstodo/CodexBar/proof/quota-warning-markers-updated-ui/proof/quota-warning-markers/before-1px-weekly-crop.png)

After: full-height punch-out warning marker in the updated UI.

![After: full-height punch-out quota warning marker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alekstodo/CodexBar/proof/quota-warning-markers-updated-ui/proof/quota-warning-markers/after-punchout-weekly-crop.png)

Side-by-side comparison:

![Before/after quota warning marker comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alekstodo/CodexBar/proof/quota-warning-markers-updated-ui/proof/quota-warning-markers/quota-warning-marker-before-after.png)

## Validation

- `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer swift test --filter MenuCardQuotaWarningMarkerTests` — 11 tests passed
- `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer swift test --filter MenuCardModelTests` — 62 tests passed
- `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer ./Scripts/lint.sh lint-macos` — exit 0; SwiftFormat reported 0/1265 files require formatting
- `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer .build/lint-tools/bin/swiftlint lint --strict Sources/CodexBar/UsageProgressBar.swift Tests/CodexBarTests/MenuCardQuotaWarningMarkerTests.swift` — 0 violations
- `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer CODEXBAR_SIGNING=adhoc ./Scripts/package_app.sh release` — release bundle built
- `codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 /Applications/CodexBar.app` — installed PR build is valid on disk and satisfies its designated requirement
